react-native-mmkv 3.2.0 (npm), built by the APK Web Lab from the published package.

The npm package ships no license file. Its package.json declares the license expression
"(MIT AND BSD-3-Clause)" and the author "Marc Rousavy <me@mrousavy.com> (https://github.com/mrousavy)":
the MIT part covers the package's own code (cpp/, android/, src/), the BSD-3-Clause part covers the
bundled Tencent MMKV core (MMKV/Core), whose source files carry this header:

    Tencent is pleased to support the open source community by making
    MMKV available.

(MMKV's own text: https://github.com/Tencent/MMKV/blob/master/LICENSE.TXT).
